reason: Machine lens: all opcodes NMOS-legal (ADC #, STA zp, LDY zp). dm_raise is zero page &71 (listing 0071), referenced only at render.6502:1549 and :1563. Three-part path (part two then part_three): old STA zp 3 + LDA zp 3 + CLC 2 + ADC # 2 + TAY 2 = 12 cycles, 8 bytes; new ADC # 2 + STA zp 3 + LDY zp 3 = 8 cycles, 6 bytes: -4 cycles, -2 bytes. Two-part path pays +2 (the ADC #8 with dm_raise never read), unmentioned in the claim, but the window's counts (STA dm_raise 3.3 and LDA dm_raise 3.3 = 1.1 each, BEQ part_three 3.3 = 1.1 taken) show no two-part draws in the measured pass. Carry: C=0 at 1548 (BCS not taken; ADC at 1546 already assumed not to carry by the existing 1552); index frame+second offset <= &5D reaches &D99B..&D9F8, every byte there <= &EC (sprites_y_offset <= &17, helicopter tables <= &EC, padding 0), so ADC #8 never carries and 1552 still sees C=0; Y for mark_part2/ren_draw_sprite is set before the ADC; part_three's Y = raise+8 as before; A reloaded at 1567, flags rewritten there. Layout: everything from old &9B31 to &B37D (no ALIGN in bank 4's section) moves -2. Branches checked by script over the listing (143): BPL each_part at &9DFF stops crossing a page (-1 per taken; window weights 9.8 cycles over ~3.25 executions = ~1.65 taken a pass, so about -1.6 cycles a pass), BNE out at &9FFE in record_differs starts crossing (+1 per taken; not in any measured window, taken only when a record's type differs). Indexed abs tables in the moved region (ck_*, straight_sprite_lo/hi) move down 2 with none at a page's &00/&01, so their crossings can only get rarer; the straight sprite data read through col_ptr may change crossings either way per column, left to the gate. No self-modifying operands or code-read-as-data in the edited lines. Net: the claim stands (4 cycles per three-part draw, 2 bytes), layout effect small and likely favourable.
